script:
"""Agency end-to-end connective-tissue test — SANDBOX, existing mechanisms only.

Founder: "Create a marketing campaign for Product X."

Runs every link with resident AIOS code against a TEMPORARY root. No repository
record is written, no agent is created canonically, no authority is granted.
Each stage records what it proved, what it refused, and where it stopped.
"""
import json
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path("/home/user/ai-operating-system")
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))

from tools.planning import AuthorityProvenance, Goal, Plan, PlanStep, PlanningSurface  # noqa: E402
from tools.agent_instance_registry import AgentInstanceRegistry  # noqa: E402
from tools.w4_delegation import AUTHORIZED_DELEGATOR, W4DelegationRegistry  # noqa: E402
from tools.w4_execution import W4Executor  # noqa: E402
from tools.w4_first_run import SELECTED_DEFINITION, FD_RECORD, DP01_RECORD, INSTANCE_KEY  # noqa: E402
from tools.p12_governance_escalation_join import join_refusals_to_grants  # noqa: E402
from tools.escalation_register import EscalationRegister  # noqa: E402
from tools.w4_continuity import reconstruct  # noqa: E402
from consumers.engineering_intelligence_agent import (  # noqa: E402
    Artifact, ConformanceCriterion, EngineeringIntelligenceAgent)
from native_core.core.infrastructure import LocalAppendOnlyStorage, LocalExecutionSubstrate  # noqa: E402
from native_core.core.runtime.composition import create_runtime  # noqa: E402
from native_core.core.runtime.execution import create_execution_layer  # noqa: E402
from native_core.core.trace import TraceWriter, TraceReader  # noqa: E402

ROOT = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="agency-e2e-"))
E = {"sandbox_root": "temporary directory, deleted after the run; nothing in the repository",
     "stages": []}


def stage(name, ok, detail, link_status):
    E["stages"].append({"stage": name, "ok": ok, "link": link_status, "detail": detail})


# 1 FOUNDER -> WORK INTAKE ------------------------------------------------------
surface = PlanningSurface()
planning = AuthorityProvenance("DP-01 §3 W2", DP01_RECORD)
goal = surface.declare(Goal(key="sandbox-product-x-campaign",
                            statement="Create a marketing campaign for Product X.",
                            authority=planning))
stage("1 founder -> work intake", True,
      f"Goal declared on the P11 planning surface: {goal.key}. Typed in by this test — "
      "no reader turns a Founder instrument into a Goal", "PARTIAL")

# 2 EXECUTIVE -> DECISION (adopted plan) ---------------------------------------
plan = surface.adopt(Plan(
    key="sandbox-product-x-campaign-plan-0", goal_key=goal.key, authority=planning,
    steps=(PlanStep("draft-campaign-brief", "Draft the campaign brief for Product X.",
                    requires_delegation=True),
           PlanStep("verify-brief-structure",
                    "Verify the brief carries objective, audience, channel and measure.",
                    depends_on=("draft-campaign-brief",), requires_delegation=True))))
stage("2 executive -> decision", True,
      f"Plan {plan.key} adopted (2 steps, authority {plan.authority_provenance()}). "
      f"Executive actor = {AUTHORIZED_DELEGATOR!r} (CEO office), not an Agent Instance",
      "VERIFIED (CEO office) / MISSING (executive Agent Instance)")

# 3 EMPLOYEE availability ------------------------------------------------------
registry = AgentInstanceRegistry(ROOT)
registration = registry.register(
    instance_key=INSTANCE_KEY, definition=SELECTED_DEFINITION,
    permitted_capabilities=("engineering-intelligence",), created_by=AUTHORIZED_DELEGATOR,
    authority=AuthorityProvenance("FD-P11-001 §7", FD_RECORD), accountable_to=AUTHORIZED_DELEGATOR)
stage("3 employee actor", True,
      f"existing definition {registration.definition_key} instantiated in the sandbox only "
      "(mirrors the resident instance record). No marketing-capable definition exists",
      "VERIFIED (mechanism) / MISSING (marketing capability)")

delegations = W4DelegationRegistry(registry, ROOT)
common = dict(delegator=AUTHORIZED_DELEGATOR, recipient_instance=registration.instance_key,
              authority=AuthorityProvenance("FD-P11-001 §9", FD_RECORD),
              lifecycle_boundary=f"one execution of plan {plan.key}",
              resource_boundary="in-memory brief only; no network; nothing persisted outside the sandbox",
              output_expectation="one check result per stated criterion",
              verification_requirement="every criterion reported satisfied or not",
              escalation_condition="any step outside the delegated work scope",
              accountable_party=AUTHORIZED_DELEGATOR,
              termination_condition="on completion of the bound plan, or revocation")

# 4a DELEGATION that exceeds the employee's capability: must fail closed ------
try:
    delegations.issue(objective="Draft the Product X campaign brief.",
                      capability_scope=("marketing",), work_scope=("draft-campaign-brief",), **common)
    stage("4a delegation beyond capability", False, "issued — capability bound NOT enforced", "FAIL")
except Exception as exc:
    stage("4a delegation beyond capability", True,
          f"refused: {type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:200]}", "VERIFIED (fail closed)")

# 4b DELEGATION within capability ----------------------------------------------
grant = delegations.issue(objective="Verify the Product X campaign brief structure.",
                          capability_scope=("engineering-intelligence",),
                          work_scope=("verify-brief-structure",), **common)
stage("4b delegation", True,
      f"{grant.delegation_id} issued: recipient {grant.recipient_instance}, "
      f"work scope {grant.work_scope}, chain {list(grant.authority_chain())}", "VERIFIED")

# 5 EXECUTION through the Execution contract into a RUNNING Runtime -------------
storage = LocalAppendOnlyStorage(ROOT / "runtime-store"); storage.provision()
substrate = LocalExecutionSubstrate(); substrate.provision()
runtime = create_runtime(runtime_id="agency-e2e-runtime", storage=storage, substrate=substrate)
runtime.initialize(); runtime.start()
writer = TraceWriter(storage)
brief = Artifact(name="product-x-campaign-brief", lines=(
    "Objective: awareness for Product X", "Audience: existing customers",
    "Channel: email"))          # deliberately no "Measure:" line
criteria = [ConformanceCriterion(n, t) for n, t in (
    ("objective", "Objective:"), ("audience", "Audience:"),
    ("channel", "Channel:"), ("measure", "Measure:"))]
agents = {}


def perform(step):
    agent = EngineeringIntelligenceAgent(artifact=brief, criteria=criteria, trace_writer=writer)
    agents[step.key] = agent
    agent.participate(create_execution_layer(runtime))          # Agent -> Execution -> Runtime
    return "; ".join(f"{r.criterion_name}={'ok' if r.satisfied else 'missing'}"
                     for r in agent.results)


report = W4Executor(grant, registry).execute_plan(plan, perform)
stage("5 execution", True,
      [{"step": o.step_key, "status": o.status, "delegation": o.delegation_id,
        "instance": o.instance_key, "detail": o.detail[:160]} for o in report.outcomes],
      "VERIFIED in sandbox (binding written by this test's perform callable)")

# 6 RESULT RETURN + identity on the Trace ---------------------------------------
records = list(TraceReader(storage).read())
ids = sorted({getattr(r, "agent_instance", None) or str(r)[:60] for r in records})
stage("6 result return", True,
      {"outcomes_carry": ["step", "delegation_id", "instance_key", "status"],
       "trace_records": len(records), "trace_agent_identity": ids,
       "participate_returns": "None (no ratified result model)"},
      "PARTIAL: outcome joins work+delegation; Trace carries the definition key only")

# 7 EXECUTIVE VERIFICATION ------------------------------------------------------
results = agents["verify-brief-structure"].results if "verify-brief-structure" in agents else ()
missing = [r.criterion_name for r in results if not r.satisfied]
verdict = "REWORK" if missing else "ACCEPT"
stage("7 executive verification", True,
      f"verification_requirement checked by this test against agent results: missing {missing} -> "
      f"{verdict}. No resident component binds delegated results to an accept/reject/rework decision",
      "PARTIAL (contract gap)")

# 8 ESCALATION to the Founder ---------------------------------------------------
esc = list(join_refusals_to_grants(ROOT, report.refusals,
                                   subject=f"plan {plan.key} / delegation {grant.delegation_id}",
                                   authority=AuthorityProvenance("FD-P11-001 §9", FD_RECORD),
                                   delegation_for=lambda r: grant.delegation_id))
reg = EscalationRegister(ROOT)
stage("8 escalation", True,
      {"escalations": esc, "open": list(reg.open_escalations()),
       "founder_response_path": "EscalationRegister.record_response(..., authority=HumanAuthority)"},
      "VERIFIED")

# 9 ORGANIZATIONAL STATE (fresh read from files only) ---------------------------
state = reconstruct(ROOT)
stage("9 organizational state", True,
      {k: state[k] for k in ("instances", "active_grants", "open_escalations", "last_plan")
       if k in state},
      "VERIFIED (reconstructed from files, no memory)")

runtime_state = getattr(runtime, "state", None)
E["runtime_state_at_end"] = str(runtime_state)
print(json.dumps(E, indent=1, default=str))
